about: The H.A.M. Hideout's people (Misthalin piece 7 step 4a): the members (pickpocketed, Pickpocketing.kt), the guards (levels 12, 18 and 22, npc-combat.json and npc-drops.json), the seated members, the Deacon, Johanhus Ulsbrecht and Jimmy the Chisel in his cell. Each tile and type is mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live, pre-Nov 2022), kept to the hideout (x 3140 to 3190, z 9600 to 9660); Sigmund, there only in The Lost Tribe, is left out. Wander ranges are guessed (5 for those who walk, 0 for the seated, the Deacon at his podium, Johanhus and Jimmy).
